architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Static assets in public/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management library (useState/useReducer suffice).

tickets.title: Create LandingPage component from sugi.dev_landing_page_integrated
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract hero section, marquee, CTA buttons. Preserve liquid glass effect (CSS backdrop-filter).
acceptance_criteria: Liquid glass effect visible in supported browsers
All links/buttons functional (route to # for now)

tickets.title: Create HomePage component from sugi.dev_portfolio_home_final
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract portfolio grid, project cards, filter tags. Reuse liquid glass styling from LandingPage.
acceptance_criteria: Project cards hover effects match design
Filter tags interactive (visual feedback only, no backend)

tickets.title: Create WorkPage component from sugi.dev_work_final
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract work timeline, project showcase, tech stack badges. Implement scroll-triggered animations for timeline items.
acceptance_criteria: Tech stack badges match design (reuse from badge_showcase_component_reference)

tickets.title: Create AboutPage component from sugi.dev_about_page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract bio section, skills chart, testimonials. Implement marquee from sugidev_marquee_about_section.

tickets.title: Create ServicesPage component from services_sugi.dev
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract service cards, pricing table, inquiry form. Reuse components from devos_table_components_reference and project_inquiry_clean_background.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing table responsive (horizontal scroll on mobile)
Inquiry form fields validate client-side (required, email format)
Service cards hover effects match design

tickets.title: Create ContactPage component from contact_clean_background
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Extract contact form, social links, map placeholder. Implement form validation and submission handler (mock API).
acceptance_criteria: Form validation for all fields (required, email format)
Social links open in new tab

tickets.title: Extract shared components from component reference screens
tickets.description: Create reusable components: Button, Badge, Card, Table. Style variants match design system. Export from src/components/index.js.
acceptance_criteria: Components match Stitch reference screens exactly
Props for size, color, disabled state

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Implement navigation bar with liquid glass effect. Set up React Router with routes for all pages. Add 404 page. Configure Tailwind CSS.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar matches design (sugidev_collection_footer_section for footer)
All routes functional (Landing, Home, Work, About, Services, Contact)
Tailwind config includes custom colors/fonts from design
Responsive navigation (mobile menu on small screens)
